_doc: Job registry. tier S = sandbox (single CPU, minutes, run by the analysis side); tier X = server (parallel / hours / large memory, run by the user). Every X job has a smoke variant that must pass in the sandbox before hand-off.

verify-core.cmd: python3 scripts/s1_build_qlr.py --variant pure28 --workers 4 && python3 scripts/s2_judge.py QLR_H_pure28.npy && python3 scripts/s3_rank19.py QLR_H_pure28.npy && python3 scripts/s12_dfz_reconcile.py
verify-core.checks: s2 violated 0; s3 18/19 with only #19 at rank 29; s12 PSITIP-INCOMPLETE

s7-witness.runtime: ~3 min in the sandbox (hash scan of the small-coordinate orbits against the pools)
s7-witness.checks: prints witnessed counts per pool; exact re-verification of every hit

session.checks: SESSION_SUMMARY.md: every step exit 0; then commit results/ once

a1-campaign.smoke: python3 scripts/s4c_qlr.py --init data/qlr_seeds60.npy --state smoke_adj.npz && python3 scripts/s4c_qlr.py --state smoke_adj.npz --budget 30 --rep-timeout 15 --max-tight 100 --workers 2
a1-campaign.checks: growth.csv rows increase; STATE line printed; no 'bad' counts

s7-pools.runtime: ~1 h on 25 cores (50 M GF(2) samples + full F_3)
s7-pools.cmd: python3 scripts/s1_build_qlr.py --variant pure28 --workers 8 && python3 scripts/s7_expand_realizable.py --H QLR_H_pure28.npy --gf2-samples 50000000
s7-pools.smoke: python3 scripts/s1_build_qlr.py --variant pure28 --workers 4 && python3 scripts/s7_expand_realizable.py --H QLR_H_pure28.npy --f3-limit 20000 --gf2-samples 200000
s7-pools.checks: pure violations 0 for both layers; pools are downcast to int8 on staging

server-batch.smoke: python3 scripts/s1_build_qlr.py --variant pure28 --workers 4 && python3 scripts/s7_expand_realizable.py --H QLR_H_pure28.npy --f3-limit 20000 --gf2-samples 200000 && python3 scripts/s10_facets.py --H QLR_H_pure28.npy --limit 2
server-batch.checks: s7 pure violations 0 twice; s10 facet classes 31 redundant 53

mplrs-completeness.cmd: python3 scripts/s4_clr_prepare.py && mpirun -np 25 mplrs clr5.ine clr5.mplrs.out
mplrs-completeness.checks: then python3 scripts/s5_orbits.py clr5.mplrs.out --expect 162 -> MATCH (optional luxury)

a2-frontier.runtime: ~1 h on 25 cores (17 undecided rays x lambda 2..4, 10 min each)
a2-frontier.cmd: python3 -c "import json,numpy as np; s=json.load(open('data/a2_frontier_status.json')); np.save('a2_undecided.npy', np.load('data/a2_frontier300.npy')[s['undecided']])" && python3 scripts/s16_stab_search.py a2_undecided.npy --lams 2 3 4 --seconds 600 --out a2_undecided_certs.npz
a2-frontier.smoke: python3 -c "import json,numpy as np; s=json.load(open('data/a2_frontier_status.json')); np.save('a2_undecided.npy', np.load('data/a2_frontier300.npy')[s['undecided']][:2])" && python3 scripts/s16_stab_search.py a2_undecided.npy --lams 2 --seconds 5 --out a2_undecided_certs.npz
a2-frontier.checks: 'realised and independently verified' lines; no WARNING lines

s17-ci.checks: 139 rays INFEASIBLE, 161 feasible for all pairs

a2-survivors.runtime: ~25-40 min on 200 cores (2,566 orbits: complete single-CI test, then annealing at 60 s for lambda=1 (2,323 orbits with N <= 64 qubits) and lambda=2 (up to 860 with 2N <= 64))

css-sweep.checks: a 'kernel: ...
